items.stem: An apprentice reports 'GEO delay is fine for gaming' with no delay figure. Which week-one ledger fix applies?
choices: Add a row with its evidence class or mark it OPEN

items.stem: A cited 3GPP delay value appears without a source_id. What is wrong?
choices: CITED_SPEC rows must name the source

items.stem: Your config file has a trailing timestamp line. What reproducibility risk does that create?
choices: Every run changes the digest and possibly the output

items.stem: A teammate's figure has a seed but no config digest. Can another campus regenerate it?
choices: Yes, if the figure looks right
Not reliably; the config used is unknown

items.stem: A satellite sits at 1,200 km nadir. Approximately what is its one-way delay?

choices: Round trip near 240 ms dominates interaction

items.stem: At low elevation, how does slant range compare with altitude?
choices: It can be several times larger

items.stem: Doubling the carrier from 2 GHz to 4 GHz does what to the LEO Doppler bound?

Which of these is a design margin rather than a measurement?

choices: Rank with the model, sweep five beams

items.stem: A test set of 8 samples gives top-1 = 0.5. What caution applies?
choices: Eight samples give a very coarse estimate

items.stem: Why might top-k reward a model that is useless in the field?
choices: It ignores how much SNR the chosen beam loses

items.stem: Which side information might a beam-selection model use?
choices: User position or a coarse channel estimate

items.stem: An apprentice uses a different random seed for baseline and model each run. What is lost?
choices: The pairing that cancels per-seed difficulty
